phase: Phase 2 Final — DNS Rebinding TOCTOU Mitigation

runtime_verification.disabled_mode_default: verified; zero Playwright processes launched; audit factors unaffected
runtime_verification.enabled_mode_runtime: verified; headless Chromium launch, DOM extraction, console/network error capture

deterministic_fixtures.js_rendered: verified; client-rendered h1 and DOM correctly extracted into browser evidence
deterministic_fixtures.timeout: verified; hard timeout budget enforced gracefully, status=TIMEOUT, zero factor disruption
deterministic_fixtures.console_network_errors: verified; captured up to 20 errors each with metadata
deterministic_fixtures.dom_snippet_capping: verified; capped at exactly 16 KB with truncation indicator

runtime_verification.api_and_pdf_compatibility: verified; AuditResponse schemas, get_audit endpoints, and PDF generation invariant

security_audit_and_hardening.redirect_ssrf_enforcement: route.fetch(max_redirects=0) boundary inspection aborts navigation before following redirects to internal destinations
security_audit_and_hardening.subresource_ssrf_enforcement: route abort for private IP resources and prohibited resource types (image, font, stylesheet)
security_audit_and_hardening.resource_exhaustion_guards: module-level concurrency semaphore (2), per-page timeout (60s), DOM cap (16KB), guaranteed finally cleanup

confirmed_fixes.defect: Premature browser import before adding _AUDITOR_PATH to sys.path caused _BROWSER_MODULE_AVAILABLE to fall back to False at runtime.
confirmed_fixes.fix: Reordered sys.path.insert(0, str(_AUDITOR_PATH)) prior to browser provider import.

confirmed_fixes.defect: Playwright Sync API threw runtime error when invoked inside active asyncio event loop thread.
confirmed_fixes.fix: Wrapped BrowserProvider.capture to detect active event loops and run in an isolated worker thread.

confirmed_fixes.defect: validate_url did not detect integer/hex IP formats or IPv4-mapped IPv6 representations.
confirmed_fixes.fix: Added _parse_ip_literal parser and IPv4-mapped address unwrapper; expanded blocked CIDRs to include CGNAT, Class E, broadcast, benchmarking, documentation.

confirmed_fixes.defect: Chromium automatically followed HTTP 3xx redirects to private/loopback IPs, bypassing pre-navigation URL validation.
confirmed_fixes.fix: Implemented request-boundary route handler using route.fetch(max_redirects=0) to inspect Location headers and abort redirects to internal targets.

remaining_risks: Playwright requires browser binaries installed in environment (playwright install chromium).
OS-level network enforcement (iptables/WFP) not implemented — recommended as production complement for container deployments.
Hard CPU/memory limits on the browser process are not implemented (no cgroup or process resource limits); this is a separate concern from the SSRF boundary.

resume_instructions.current_state: Phase 2 Final complete. DNS rebinding TOCTOU mitigated. 234 tests passing.
resume_instructions.next_phase: Phase 3 (if and only if authorized; do not start automatically).
